repository_discipline.rationale: The role decision stays in collector provenance and artifact admission owners; scripts remain composition-only and all claims remain evidence-bounded.

dimensions.name: responsibility-ownership
dimensions.evidence: fada_async_collection emits source provenance and fada_artifact_admission validates it; neither owner selects or loads a second final policy.

dimensions.name: public-interface
dimensions.evidence: The existing collection summary field remains the only public role surface: main rows are unified and intermediate rows are walking.

dimensions.name: dependency-direction
dimensions.evidence: Admission consumes persisted summary provenance and does not reach into worker-private teacher state or checkpoint format details.

dimensions.name: state-lifecycle
dimensions.evidence: The repair adds no mutable state, resource, process, optimizer, checkpoint, or rollback path; the formal transaction still closes its worker and reloads schema 5.

dimensions.name: change-surface
dimensions.evidence: The exact failed invariant is repaired at two existing Pinch Points with direct counterexamples; no wrapper, schema, module, or parallel mode was added.

dimensions.name: evidence-boundary
dimensions.evidence: Direct RED/GREEN tests, the production-route formal test, 605 related tests, Ruff, Pyright, and diff checks support offline engineering and formal-route claims only.

dimensions.name: tensor-provenance
dimensions.evidence: Main and intermediate role identity remains explicit per persisted collection summary; replay row shapes, masks, and 66/29/3 semantics are unchanged.

dimensions.name: gradient-update-boundary
dimensions.evidence: The repair does not alter optimizer ownership; the formal route observes one IDM update followed by one fixed-IDM Planner update.

dimensions.name: persistence-evaluation
dimensions.evidence: The formal test saves schema 5, strictly reloads both optimizer states, produces a finite [1,29] action, and leaves no child process or temporary artifact residue.

residual_risks.description: The formal audit uses a fake environment and synthetic unified Oracle, not the approved server checkpoint or native MuJoCo runtime.
residual_risks.disposition: Keep this as LIVE_REQUIRED evidence for any later environment-specific claim; it does not block the technical long-training gate.

residual_risks.description: No offline formal test establishes convergence, locomotion stability, or policy quality.
residual_risks.disposition: Require a separately authorized campaign and post-training policy-quality audit.
